categories.main_business_segments: Taiwan Mobile operates primarily in four business segments: Personal User Business Group providing mobile telecommunications and value-added services; Enterprise User Business Group offering integrated ICT services including mobile, fixed network, cloud, IoT, and cybersecurity; Household User Business Group delivering cable TV, digital TV, and broadband internet services; and Retail Business through momo e-commerce and TV shopping platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced telecommunications technologies including 5G networks, VoLTE, O-RAN architecture, AI integration for voice authentication, AI customer service, digital identity verification (eKYC), cybersecurity solutions, cloud computing, IoT, and smart home technologies. It also develops proprietary AI models and platforms for personalized services and network optimization, and operates electric vehicle charging infrastructure with high-speed charging technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taiwan Mobile serves a broad customer base including individual consumers for mobile and broadband services, enterprises requiring integrated ICT solutions, households subscribing to cable and digital TV, and retail customers through its e-commerce and TV shopping channels. The enterprise segment targets industries such as manufacturing, retail, healthcare, finance, and government sectors, while the personal and household segments focus on the Taiwan domestic market including outlying islands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations cover Taiwan’s main island and outlying islands such as Kinmen and Matsu, with international roaming services extending to over 200 countries. Its retail and e-commerce services are primarily focused on the Taiwan market. The company also pursues international expansion in ICT services and AI applications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taiwan Mobile operates primarily in the downstream segment of the telecommunications supply chain, providing end-user services and integrated ICT solutions. It also engages in upstream activities such as network infrastructure deployment and technology development, and midstream activities including cloud services and cybersecurity. The company collaborates with strategic partners for technology and service integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on accelerating the development of 'Telco+Tech' business by integrating AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, IoT, and green energy solutions. R&D initiatives emphasize AI-powered voice authentication, AI customer service, digital identity verification, cybersecurity enhancements, smart home IoT standards, and electric vehicle charging technologies. Sustainability and net-zero carbon goals are integrated into innovation strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Taiwan Mobile generates revenue primarily through subscription fees for mobile, fixed-line, broadband, and TV services, as well as sales of value-added services and devices. The enterprise segment contributes through ICT service contracts, consulting, managed services, and cloud solutions on a subscription or usage basis. The retail segment earns revenue from product sales via e-commerce and TV shopping platforms. Additional income comes from advertising and strategic investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top three telecom operators in Taiwan, holding approximately 32% market share in mobile subscribers, ranking second domestically. It competes with other major telecom providers such as Chunghwa Telecom and FarEasTone. Taiwan Mobile differentiates itself through integrated ICT services, AI innovation, and sustainability leadership, positioning as a technology-driven telecom leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Taiwan Mobile reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$199.4 billion in the latest fiscal year, reflecting a 9% growth driven by the merger with Taiwan Star. EBITDA grew 19% to NT$42.5 billion, and operating profit increased 15%, reaching an 11-year high. The company maintains strong cash flow and financial flexibility, with a workforce of over 10,000 employees and ongoing investments in network and technology expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taiwan Mobile emphasizes delivering differentiated value through integrated 'Telco+Tech' services combining telecommunications with AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and green energy solutions. It offers unique bundled packages, exclusive content, and advanced digital identity and anti-fraud services. The company’s commitment to sustainability, high-quality network coverage including rural areas, and customer-centric innovation underpin its competitive advantage.
